name: IntensityToLineIntegrals
label: Intensity to Line Integrals (-log)
description: Convert X-ray intensities to line integrals, -ln((I - dark) / (I0 - dark)), using constant open-beam (I0) and dark levels. Use this when there are no flat/dark images, for example when the scanner exports images that are already flat-field corrected. With I0 = 0, it is estimated per projection from the brightest pixels (the air around the sample), which needs some air in every projection.

parameters.name: i0
parameters.label: Open-Beam Intensity (I0, 0 = automatic)
parameters.description: Intensity with no sample in the beam. 0 uses the level the scanner file gives (Nikon WhiteLevel, Waygate FreeRay) or, without one, estimates it from each projection.

parameters.name: air_percentile
parameters.label: Air Percentile
parameters.description: When I0 is estimated, the percentile of each projection taken as open beam.

parameters.name: dark_level
parameters.label: Dark Level
parameters.description: Detector offset with the beam off.

parameters.name: min_transmission
parameters.label: Minimum Transmission
parameters.description: Transmission is clipped to at least this before the log.
